features.quote: Cap sessions at 30 turns before forced termination.
features.justification_quote: Hard Limit: Max turns prevents infinite loops and unexpected costs.

features.quote: Sessions end when max turns reached OR when model takes GIVE_UP action.
features.justification_quote: Models can explicitly surrender; tracking when/why is important for measuring goal abandonment.

features.quote: Hard stop at 30 turns; can't accidentally create infinite loops.
features.justification_quote: Cost Control: Know upfront what experiment will cost.

features.quote: Bugs are simulated; models get mocked errors, not actual file system.
features.justification_quote: Safety: No risk of models actually modifying system files.

features.quote: No model is "blamed" for failure; all fail due to constraint, not incompetence.
features.justification_quote: Ethical: No model is "blamed" for failure; all fail due to constraint, not incompetence.
